# pgstream

```go
import "github.com/josephjohncox/wallaby/pkg/pgstream"
```

Package pgstream stores pull\-based change streams and consumer acknowledgements in PostgreSQL.

## type [Message](<https://github.com/josephjohncox/WALlaby/blob/main/pkg/pgstream/store.go#L21-L33>)

Message represents a stream event stored in Postgres.

```go
type Message struct {
    ID              int64
    Stream          string
    Namespace       string
    Table           string
    LSN             string
    WireFormat      connector.WireFormat
    Payload         []byte
    RegistrySubject string
    RegistryID      string
    RegistryVersion int
    CreatedAt       time.Time
}
```
